sections.title: Quilts that leave the building
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: {{guild_name}} sews for hospitals, shelters, and first responders. Meetings are {{meeting_info}}.

items.title: Hospital cribs
items.body: 36 by 45, washed, labeled, dropped off quarterly.

items.title: Shelter laps
items.body: Sturdy cotton, no white grounds, kits in the closet.

items.title: Fidget quilts
items.body: Small textured pieces for the memory-care unit.

items.title: First-responder throws
items.body: Fire and EMS stations request a stack each winter.

sections.title: You do not have to attend meetings to sew
sections.body: Take a kit home. Bring it back finished. Membership is optional for volunteers, required to vote.

sections.title: Where the quilts go
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Named partners, sizes, and how a finished top gets from your machine to a bed.

items.title: Children's hospital
items.body: Crib and toddler sizes. No buttons, no three-dimensional applique, no wool.

items.title: Family shelter
items.body: Twin throws. Darker palettes hold up better in the wash.

items.title: Memory care
items.body: Fidget quilts, 18 inches square, with zippers, ribbon, and large buttons sewn on hard.

items.title: Opportunity quilt
items.body: One guild-pieced quilt a year, ticketed to fund batting and labels.

sections.title: How to help this month
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Sew, longarm, bind, drive, or buy batting. None of those require a title.

items.title: Take a kit
items.body: Tops are bagged with batting, backing, and a label. Sign the clipboard.

items.title: Longarm a stack
items.body: Charity chair will send pressed, pinned tops. Edge-to-edge is fine.

items.title: Bind at sew day
items.body: Second Saturday, 10 to 3. Machines provided if you do not want to bring yours.

items.title: Deliver
items.body: Quarterly drop-offs. Mileage is not reimbursed; coffee is.

sections.heading: Tell us what you can do

sections.title: Membership
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Volunteers can sew without joining. Members vote, borrow from the library, and get the newsletter.

sections.html: A portion of every dues payment buys batting and labels. If you only want to sew, skip this page and take a kit.

sections.title: Meetings and sew days
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: A short meeting, then sewing. Workshops are rare and cheap.

sections.note: The charity closet is open thirty minutes before the meeting.
